# Repository guidance

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before making
changes, together with any applicable directory instructions. It is the shared
source for architecture, ownership, security, compatibility and verification.

This is FNLLA Core, the provider-neutral MIT runtime. Keep it independent of the
commercial FNLLA package and provider SDKs. Confirm APIs in local source, preserve
existing work, and report checks actually run. Publication requires explicit owner
authorization. Maintain detailed rules in AGENTS.md, not in this bridge.
